The mod's identity is uncertain; the best match is aninusmuffin/serversleep ('Server50Sleep', which sets the playersSleepingPercentage gamerule to 50). The only Fabric-mod source is tag 1.19, whose fabric.mod.json has id 'serversleep', version '1.19' and depends {fabricloader: '>=0.14.9', fabric: '*', minecraft: '~1.19', java: '>=17'}.
